description: Client-side script for TinyMCE media plugin, handling media embedding, parameter serialization, media type detection, and preview generation.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the media dialog, sets up form elements, loads media list, and prepares the preview.

methods.name: insertMedia
methods.description: Inserts or updates media embed code based on form inputs, handling both inline and new media elements.

methods.name: getMediaListHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML for media list dropdown if available.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Determines media type based on URL, including special handling for YouTube and Google videos.

methods.name: switchType
methods.description: Switches media type based on URL, updates form accordingly.

methods.name: changedType
methods.description: Shows or hides media-specific options based on selected media type.

methods.name: serializeParameters
methods.description: Serializes media parameters into a string for embedding.

methods.name: getBool
methods.description: Retrieves boolean value from form element and formats as string.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves string value from form element and formats as string.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Retrieves integer value from form element and formats as string.

methods.name: jsEncode
methods.description: Encodes string for safe inclusion in JavaScript code.

methods.name: generatePreview
methods.description: Generates HTML preview of the media object based on form inputs.
